evidence: News flow heading into May 16 shows market sentiment attempting to stabilize following the severe Terra/UST collapse. Multiple prominent analysts and technical strategists (including Justin Bennett, Pentoshi, and Will Clemente) highlight signs of an exhaustion low, reclaiming of short-term support, and bullish divergence signaling a near-term relief bounce. Additional support comes from reporting on whale accumulation at sub-$30k levels and legal recognition of Bitcoin property rights by the Shanghai High People's Court. However, ongoing uncertainty surrounding the liquidation of Luna Foundation Guard's large Bitcoin reserves limits stronger upside conviction.
limitations: Evidence is primarily composed of technical analyst commentary and retrospective coverage of the Terra/LUNA collapse.
Macro volatility and liquidity conditions following the UST depeg event remain exceptionally unpredictable over a 24-hour horizon.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
reference_price_definition: Binance BTCUSDT daily candle close at the contract timestamp
